summary: Iteration 16 — Full backend + frontend QA of 'Mi proceso' Home preview, redesigned /process dashboard and new /process-report (AMODO Plus) flow. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_amodo_iter16_process.py: GET /api/process returns the required daily/activities/tasks/feelings/medications/expenses structure for days=7/30/90; days=15 -> 422; today='bad-date' -> 422; 'compare' present ONLY for the Plus patient and absent for the Gratis caregiver; real-data roundtrip (create journal + event + expense for today -> reflected in daily.moods, daily.events, daily.spent, activities.total, feelings.days_logged, expenses.total; delete -> entries disappear from daily and totals); POST /api/process/reports as caregiver -> 403; sections=[] -> 422; start>end -> 422; range>366 days -> 422; create+download yields a %PDF response with Content-Type application/pdf served with NO auth header; GET /api/process/reports returns only own reports (caregiver cannot see patient's); POST /api/process/reports/{id}/link regenerates a new /api/process-download/<code> path different from the old one; unknown id -> 404; GET /api/process-download/<invalid> -> 404; OLD endpoint POST /api/process/pdf-link responds 405 (removed). Privacy: caregiver's GET /api/process does NOT contain the patient's journal note. Frontend (390x844, mobile): Home for demo patient (Plus) shows section home-process after quick signals and before 'A tu modo' with period buttons home-process-period-7/30/90 (all three toggle correctly without horizontal overflow at 390x844), day cells home-process-days-YYYY-MM-DD open process-day-sheet exposing process-day-edit-note and process-day-edit-mood, stat tiles home-process-stat-feel/acts/doses (note: the implementation uses the key 'doses' rather than 'meds'; there is no money stat tile on Home — the money total is shown on /process as process-tile-spent), report card home-process-report with button home-process-report-button routes to /process-report, 'Ver todo' routes to /process. Home for non-Plus (cancelled Plus temporarily via POST /api/me/plus/cancel -> 200): home-process-plus-hint appears, home-process-report / button are hidden, and the 7-day preview still renders with 7 day cells. /process: process-period-7/30/90 switch content, process-filter-all/feel/acts/meds/money/notes all present, tiles process-tile-feel/appointments/treatments/doses/tasks/spent render, mood rows process-mood-Tranquilo/a, process-mood-En calma, process-mood-Con energía, process-mood-Cansado/a open process-mood-sheet with day listing, timeline rows process-event-<id> present, process-pdf button routes to /process-report for Plus and to /plus for non-Plus. Empty state process-empty verified on caregiver 7-day view with its two compact buttons process-empty-mood and process-empty-agenda. /process-report (Plus): report-period-7/30/90/custom chips all work; custom reveals report-start and report-end date pickers; report-section-feelings/appointments/treatments/medications/activities/expenses/notes toggles, report-include-name switch, report-preview updates, report-generate creates a report and report-download + report-share become available, and the new report shows up in report-history as report-item-<id>. Non-Plus /process-report shows the Plus gate ('Reportes con AMODO Plus' + 'Conocer Plus') and the generate control is absent. Perfil still exposes 'Mi proceso' (3 occurrences in the profile text). Horizontal overflow check (scrollWidth == clientWidth) passes at 390x844 across Home, /process, /process-report, and the empty-state view. No React Native red screen, no console errors. Pre-existing expo-router/unstable-native-tabs deprecation warning still present (carried over from iter 13–15). demo@amodo.app left on AMODO Plus (verified /api/me plan.tier='plus'). No TEST_ records left (the 3 roundtrip records were deleted in the pytest fixture).

react_native_issues.issue: Console still logs 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs is deprecated. Use expo-router/native-tabs instead.' Not introduced in iter 16. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx

critical_code_review_comments: backend/process.py: _days() correctly rejects anything outside (7, 30, 90) with 422 and process_data() builds a complete daily list (len == days) with one entry per day — no gaps, verified by pytest TestProcessEndpoint.test_valid_days_structure for all three periods.
backend/process.py: GET /api/process gates 'compare' behind is_plus(user) so Gratis users do not get the before/after totals (confirmed via test_non_plus_no_compare). Good separation.
backend/process.py:329 correctly validates start>end and (end-start).days>366 BEFORE PDF generation; pytest verified both with 422.

backend/process.py:_link() generates secrets.token_urlsafe(24) + 15-minute expiry; POST /api/process/reports/{rid}/link always creates a new row (does not update the old), which keeps old links valid until they expire (confirmed new path != old path).

backend/process.py:process_download() does NOT require Authorization (public-by-token); it re-checks is_plus(user) on the owner at download time, so if the user cancels Plus mid-flight the link would 404. Correct for the feature requirement.

frontend/app/process.tsx:67-79 renders process-empty only when d.empty is true; the empty block has exactly 2 small buttons (process-empty-mood, process-empty-agenda) per the design — verified on caregiver 7d view.

frontend/src/components/process-preview.tsx: stat keys are 'feel','acts','doses' (not 'meds'/'money') — this matches the review request wildcard home-process-stat-* but the review request text mentions 'meds/money' which map to 'doses' and are not displayed on Home (money lives on /process as process-tile-spent). Consider aligning naming or clarifying the spec, but no bug.

frontend/app/process-report.tsx: non-Plus user correctly sees the Plus gate card; the generate/section/preview controls are gated off; the deep link /process-report from /process->process-pdf routes non-Plus users to /plus — matches the spec.
seed_data_creation: pytest fixtures created and deleted 3 TEST_ records on demo@amodo.app (journal 'TEST_PROCESS_JOURNAL', event 'TEST_PROCESS_EVENT', expense 'TEST_PROCESS_EXP') plus a 'TEST_PRIV_JOURNAL' journal — all removed via DELETE /api/records/<kind>/<id> during teardown. The UI testing generated a few process_reports entries (not TEST_-prefixed, there is no delete endpoint for reports in the API) that remain in the patient's report history; they are part of normal product usage. demo@amodo.app was cancelled from Plus and reactivated at the end; final /api/me plan.tier='plus' confirmed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Env var for the preview backend is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Token in web localStorage is stored as a JSON-quoted string under key 'amodo_token' — read via JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('amodo_token')). To bypass the require_plus gate when toggling for UI, use page.evaluate fetch with the token (same-origin) — a container-side urllib call was returning 403 from the ingress for /api/me/plus/cancel|activate even with a valid Bearer token; the in-page fetch worked fine. POST /api/process/pdf-link is REMOVED (responds 405 METHOD NOT ALLOWED, not 404) — the test accepts either. The Home preview uses stat key 'doses' rather than 'meds' and does not expose a money stat tile; the /process page is where process-tile-spent lives. The empty state on /process only appears when backend returns d.empty==true, which happens only when feel_days + events + doses + expenses + signals are all zero in the range; a 30-day view on the caregiver still has 1 seeded activity so switch to 7-day to see process-empty.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no regressions found. All features from the review request are implemented and work end-to-end.
